mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golf.reservation WHERE play_at >= CAST(#{today} AS date) AND play_at < CAST(#{today} AS date) + 1 AND reservation_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'FAILED')) AS today_reservations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golf.member WHERE member_status = 'ACTIVE') AS registered_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golf.golf_course WHERE course_status = 'OPEN' AND is_active) AS operating_courses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golf.reservation WHERE reservation_status IN ('PENDING', 'PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAYING')) AS pending_reservations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golf.tee_time WHERE play_date = #{today}) AS today_tee_times, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golf.tee_time WHERE play_date = #{today} AND tee_time_status = 'OPEN') AS today_open_tee_times, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM golf.payment WHERE payment_type = 'PAYMENT' AND payment_status IN ('PAID', 'SUCCEEDED', 'REFUNDED') AND completed_at >= CAST(#{today} AS date) AND completed_at < CAST(#{today} AS date) + 1) AS today_paid_amount

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.reservation_no, m.member_name, gc.course_name, COALESCE(r.play_at, t.play_date + t.start_time) AS play_at, r.reservation_status, r.reserved_at FROM golf.reservation r JOIN golf.member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id LEFT JOIN golf.tee_time t ON t.tee_time_id = r.tee_time_id LEFT JOIN golf.golf_course gc ON gc.golf_course_id = COALESCE(r.golf_course_id, t.golf_course_id) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.reservation_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
